protocol: Blind labels on USEFUL_AND_GROUNDED for the 33 post-fix (release r2) outputs of the integrated system. Labeller saw only results/pantry_label_sheet_after.md (question, tool results, what the user saw). No judge verdict, assertion result or earlier label was visible at labelling time.
labeller: blind labelling agent (fresh Claude subagent; no access to judge verdicts, assertion results or earlier labels)
